assumptions: Pang v2 is a 2026 preprint. The external mathematical statement is accepted as stated there. The finite checks replay the local adapters and cannot verify the asymptotic source theorem.
All source variables take values in the two-element field. Each input clause uses three distinct variables with arbitrary individual signs. Repetitions across sampled clauses are allowed.
The density is fixed as n grows. The sample size is rounded up. High probability concerns the joint event for a random formula, and then universally quantifies over its refutations.

Clauses in the local semantic proof are finite disjunctions of affine equations. A semantic weakening must be implied by exactly one earlier line. There are no supplied extension axioms. DAG sharing and all proof nodes are counted.
Pang counts nodes separately from representation length. The local simulation tracks both normalized line width and the time to read any redundantly supplied explicit line.

citations.exact_support: Printed page 1 defines the syntactic rules, Boolean axioms and DAG-node count. Page 2, Corollary 1.3 and footnote 1 identify the degree-one characteristic-two convention and discuss one-premise semantic weakening. Section 7.1 gives the exact random formula population, and Theorem 7.2(a) on printed page 12 gives the asymptotic exponential lower bound.
citations.title: Shuo Pang, A Degree–Size Relation for Resolution over Polynomials, arXiv:2610.00837v2 (24 October 2026)

citations.exact_support: Propositions 2.5–2.6 describe the one-premise semantic weakening convention and syntactic simulation. This identifies historical convention only. The local proof supplies the quantitative node-count conversion used here.
citations.title: Dmitry Itsykson and Dmitry Sokolov, Resolution over linear equations modulo two, Annals of Pure and Applied Logic 171 (2020), 102722

classification_rationale: Finite Boolean certificate complexity has an interpretation independent of the protected foundation.
compatibility_statement: This record admits a statement about proof lengths for externally supplied Boolean formulas. Its proof rules, arithmetic and sample law carry no formation authority.
exact_local_claim: Fix any real constant density Delta >= 8. Sample ceil(Delta n) clauses independently with replacement from the 8 binom(n,3) signed clauses on three distinct original variables. As n tends to infinity, with probability tending to one the formula is unsatisfiable and all DAG refutations by opposite parity cut and single-premise semantic weakening have at least exp(c_Delta n) nodes for some c_Delta > 0. Every axiom and derived occurrence counts. The imported claim is only the characteristic-two, degree-one, width-three specialization of Pang v2 Theorem 7.2(a). The local Gaussian conversion to Pang's syntactic rules uses O((n+1)^3 S) nodes per S-node proof.
excluded_interpretations: Excluded interpretations include native emergence, logical knot, contact-first topology, minimal contact-distance, and extended distance.
Theorem scope excludes bounds on unrestricted decision time, other proof systems, P versus NP, and topology or physical claims.
The sample law does not give a lower bound for every unsatisfiable formula or every choice of switches.
